paras: Lepidoblepharis victormartinezi is a species of gecko, a lizard in the family Sphaerodactylidae. The species is endemic to Panama.
The specific name, victormartinezi, is in honor of Panamanian herpetologist Victor Martínez Cortés.
L. victormartinezi is found in Colón Province, Panamá.
The snout-to-vent length (SVL) of adults of L. victormartinezi is 25–27 mm (0.98–1.06 in).
